run_evaluation_3dpw: run evaluation on 3DPW dataset with a trained HMR model checkpoint and batch size 32
run_evaluation_h36m: run evaluation on Human3.6M Protocol 1 dataset with a trained model checkpoint and log frequency 50
run_evaluation_lsp: run evaluation on LSP dataset for mask and part segmentation with a trained model checkpoint
run_evaluation_mpi_inf_3dhp: run evaluation on MPI-INF-3DHP dataset with a trained model checkpoint and custom batch size
save_evaluation_results: run evaluation and save predictions including pose, betas, camera, and joints to a pickle file
